apps.name: SupplyHub
apps.description: Third-party vendor billing portal. Our suppliers publish invoices and credit notes here. Documents list at /documents (filterable by supplier and type, sortable by date); each document page has a PDF download containing the amounts, payment terms and due date.
apps.auth: Web login form. Secrets: supplyhub.email, supplyhub.password

apps.name: Northwind AP
apps.description: Our internal accounts-payable system (the 'internal system' / ERP). Staff enter vendor bills via the web UI (Enter bill form at /bills/new), browse bills at /bills and the vendor master at /vendors. Bills can be approved for payment from the bill page. A read-only reporting REST API is also available: GET /api/vendors, GET /api/bills?vendor_id=&invoice_number=&status=, GET /api/bills/{id}.
apps.auth: Web login form. Secrets: erp.username, erp.password. API: header 'Authorization: Bearer {{secret:erp.api_token}}'

example_tasks.label: Invoice → ERP (canonical)
example_tasks.task: Find the latest invoice from Acme Supplies, extract the amount and due date, enter it into our internal system, and tell me once it is done.

example_tasks.label: Ambiguous vendor
example_tasks.task: Find the latest invoice from Acme and enter it into our internal system.

example_tasks.label: Vendor missing from ERP
example_tasks.task: Enter the latest invoice from Umbrella Facilities into Northwind AP.

example_tasks.label: Overdue report (read + files)
example_tasks.task: Which bills in our AP system are overdue and not yet paid? Write a CSV report named overdue_bills.csv with bill ref, vendor, invoice number, due date, amount and days overdue, and summarize it for me.

example_tasks.label: Reconcile portal vs ERP
example_tasks.task: Check which open invoices on SupplyHub from vendors in our vendor master have not been entered into Northwind AP yet, and enter the missing ones.
